title: Onboard 'Cobalt-6B' v1.0: metadata, performance profiles, and changelog automation
author: Amara Singh
description:
Motivation: Add support for the new open-source 'Cobalt-6B' model to the model registry with curated metadata, performance profiles (throughput & latency), and an automated changelog entry generation step so releases are discoverable in the Console and CLI. This PR bundles the model metadata, perf profile artifacts produced by the perf lab, unit tests, and a small enhancement to the changelog generator so model onboarding items are automatically included when model metadata is merged.

What I changed: 1) models/cobalt-6b/metadata.yaml — canonical model metadata (display_name, architecture, tokenizer, supported_quantizations, recommended_profiles). 2) models/cobalt-6b/perf_profiles/throughput.json & latency.json — perf-profile artifacts generated from perf-canary jobs (N=30 runs, median/95th stats). 3) docs/models/cobalt-6b.md — short doc page with usage notes and recommended runtimes. 4) tests/model-registry/test_cobalt_metadata.py — unit tests verifying schema, tokenizer validity, and profile sanity checks. 5) scripts/changelog/generate_release_notes.py — add model-onboard hook to include entries from models/*/changelog.yaml and include perf-profile summary blocks. 6) scripts/changelog/templates/model_onboard.md.j2 — template used by CI to render release notes. 7) ci/model-registry.yaml — CI matrix entry to run perf-profile sanity check stage for model registry PRs.

Testing & CI: CI matrix included unit tests (fast), schema-validate, and a lightweight perf-profile sanity check that validates numbers are within expected bounds compared to baseline models. A nightly perf job will still run the full perf bench; this PR only adds the sanity gate so obviously bad profiles fail PRs. All CI checks passed after addressing a flaky tokenizer fixture (see commits).

Rollout plan: Merge to main will: a) register model metadata in the registry, b) surface the model doc page in the Console after the docs pipeline runs, c) trigger changelog generation which will include a short model onboarding note for the next release. We will monitor the first 48h of requests routed to Cobalt-6B for latency regressions and unexpected high error rates.

Backward compatibility: No breaking changes to existing models or APIs. The changelog enhancement is additive and guarded behind a small feature flag in the generator (default: enabled).

Related: ENG-2431 (model onboarding workflow), PM-112 (Cobalt pricing/packaging). Support ticket SUP-705 tracked a customer request to get model metadata surfaced earlier in release notes.

Checklist:
- [x] Add model metadata and perf artifacts
- [x] Add unit tests and CI gate
- [x] Changelog generator hook and template
- [x] Docs page stub
- [x] Reviewer approvals

Notes: Perf profiles included are the curated median/95th percentiles for the recommended runtime configs. The perf artifacts include a small metadata block (hardware, batch size, seq len) so the Console can pick the correct profile for routing/cost estimates.
